title: Senior Academics Manager
description:
Role Purpose:

To lead the design, structuring, and quality governance of K–12 instructional and curriculum frameworks in STEM, Robotics, Coding, Artificial Intelligence, etc., translating academic content into coherent, age-appropriate, and classroom-ready learning resources that are pedagogically robust, consistent, and implementation-feasible.

Key Responsibilities:

• Structure end-to-end curriculum frameworks and learning progressions across K–12 in STEM, Robotics, Coding, and AI.

• Ensure strong alignment between curriculum intent, instructional design methodology, hands-on activities, projects, and assessment strategies.

• Embed experiential, inquiry-based, problem-solving, and learner-centric pedagogical approaches within curriculum designs.

• Be responsible for design and development of teaching – learning resources, to ensure academic accuracy, conceptual clarity, consistency across grades and alignment with NEP 2020 recommendations, NCF guidelines and SDG goals.

• Ensure age-appropriateness, cognitive load balance, and practical classroom feasibility of learning designs, including lab and activity components.

• Identify design gaps, redundancies, or misalignments and recommend data informed improvements to enhance learning effectiveness.

• Collaborate closely with academic, product, and delivery teams to ensure curriculum/ content usability, teacher readiness, and smooth classroom implementation.

• Be responsible for the design, development and quality of teacher training design.

Qualifications: B.Tech / M.Tech in Engineering, Technology, or a related STEM discipline

Experience:

• Minimum 5 years of experience in K–12 curriculum and content design for STEM, Robotics, Coding, and AI.

• Exposure to classroom implementation, pilots, or teacher training is preferred.

Core Competencies:

• Strong understanding of STEM, Robotics, Coding, and AI concepts at the K–12 level.

• Solid grounding in K–12 pedagogy and curriculum structuring.

• Clear understanding of school board alignment requirements for STEM, Robotics, and AI.

• Ability to guide teams, maintain design standards, and ensure consistency across grades.

• Strong attention to academic accuracy, design quality, and classroom feasibility.

title: STEM Trainer
description:
Role Description

As a STEM Trainer, you will engage students through hands-on learning in Robotics, Coding, Electronics, IoT, and STEM activities using innovative Tinker kits and practical projects.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct interactive STEM and Robotics sessions in schools

• Train students using activity-based learning methods

• Handle Arduino, ESP32, sensors, actuators, and robotics kits

• Support workshops, exhibitions, demos, and teacher training programs

• Inspire students to innovate, build, and solve real-world problems. Document activities and school and student progress.

title: VP- Marketing
description:
Key Responsibilities

Strategic Marketing Leadership

Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies aligned with business and revenue goals.

  • Drive market positioning, brand awareness, and customer engagement across schools, educators, parents, and institutional partners.

  • Identify growth opportunities within the EdTech and K-12 ecosystem.

AI-Driven Marketing & Automation

  • Leverage AI tools and marketing automation platforms to improve campaign efficiency and personalization.

  • Implement AI-powered lead nurturing, CRM workflows, predictive analytics, and customer segmentation.

  • Use AI-driven insights for improving campaign performance, engagement, and conversion rates.

  • Explore emerging AI technologies for content generation, customer interaction, and marketing intelligence.

Growth & Demand Generation

  • Lead digital marketing initiatives including SEO, SEM, paid campaigns, social media, webinars, influencer collaborations, and content marketing.

  • Drive B2B lead generation for school partnerships and institutional collaborations.

  • Optimize customer acquisition funnels and improve conversion metrics.

Brand & Communication

  • Strengthen Get Set Learn’s positioning in AI education, future skills, and K-12 transformation.

  • Lead PR, thought leadership, events, partnerships, and communication strategies.

  • Ensure brand consistency across digital, offline, and partner channels.

Product Marketing & Go-to-Market

  • Collaborate with product and academic teams to launch new programs and AI learning initiatives.

  • Build GTM strategies, messaging frameworks, and market penetration campaigns.

  • Support sales teams with presentations, brochures, case studies, and marketing collateral.

Team Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and manage a high-performing marketing team.

  • Manage agencies, external partners, and technology vendors.

  • Foster a data-driven, agile, and innovation-led marketing culture.

Analytics & Performance

  • Own marketing KPIs including CAC, ROI, lead generation, engagement, conversion, and retention metrics.

  • Develop dashboards and performance reporting frameworks for leadership reviews.

  • Manage and optimize marketing budgets effectively.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related field; MBA preferred.

  • 8–11 years of progressive marketing experience with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role.

  • Prior experience in the EdTech, Education, K-12, Learning, or SaaS industry is mandatory.

  • Strong expertise in digital marketing, growth marketing, brand strategy, and AI-enabled marketing technologies.

  • Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, and analytics platforms.

  • Proven ability to scale brand presence and lead generation in high-growth environments.

title: Instructional Designer
description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design of lessons, activities, and assessments aligned with NEP 2020, NCF, and SDG-linked priorities.

  • Curriculum design as per NEP 2020 and global standards and mapping to the same

  • Ensure strong alignment between learning objectives, pedagogy, activities, and assessments.

  • Apply experiential, learner-centric, and inquiry-driven approaches purposefully.

  • Develop and review learning materials, teacher guides, assessment and other resources.

  • Ensure age-appropriateness, conceptual accuracy, and cognitive load balance.

  • Identify and resolve instructional gaps or misalignments.

  • Work closely with academic, editorial, media, and delivery teams to ensure quality outcomes.

Skills sets:

  1. Team management skills

  2. Excellent written and oral communication

  3. Readiness to explore latest EdTech and AI tools

  4. Awareness about latest trends in K12 education

  5. Research oriented

Qualifications:

  • Degree or postgraduate diploma in Instructional Design, Education, or related fields.

  • B.Sc/ M.Sc./ B.Tech/ M.Tech - STEM background preferred.

Experience:

  • Minimum 4-6years of experience in instructional design, learning design, or content development.

  • Preferred: Experience with K–12 and/or STEM-related programmes.
